photo_crosscheck.77: Printed63 east survey elevation corroborates two-storey southern annex and one-storey northern annex.

coordinate_system.u: north to south; plan left to right
coordinate_system.v: east to west; plan top to bottom
coordinate_system.origin: main-body northeast plan corner, excluding east annex

plan_controls.note: Chamfer is approximately 45 degrees, not central projecting rectangle. Thin bands/cornices project beyond main walls. Precise render edges differ slightly.

height_controls.note: Belt center is a facade control, not proven exact finished-floor datum; interior floor plate can be estimated near this level. Do not promote roof cornice to a full peripheral parapet.
height_controls.primary: Page204 using its own 0–750cm bar; page205 corroborates. Page203 uses its separate 0–250cm bar and must not be calibrated at24px/m.

page203_crosscheck.difference_vs204: approximately0.03–0.05m (<1%), within raster uncertainty; do not force exact equality or average

roof_controls.main_flat_roof: Exposed flat RC slab, no all-around tall parapet; raised entrance sign parapet only on diagonal facade.
roof_controls.roof_body_alignment: Calibrate independently by same page bar; roof has own origin, never copy second-floor pixel origin. Offset outer roof around main body approximately 0.25–0.35 m.
roof_controls.stair_roof: single slope high at north end, low at south end; west/east profiles in 204/205 and section207; not a flat water tank.
roof_controls.roof_bases: 201 roof shows several rectangular and two circular RC bases. Heights are not dimensioned. Only low explicit proxy pads if disclosed; do not invent tanks from circles.
roof_controls.equipment_exclusions: Loose equipment, turbine details, wires and clutter may be excluded explicitly; roof base positions can be traced but unknown elevations must not be claimed exact.
roof_controls.stair_door: 204 north elevation shows a framed rectangular door-like face on north/high end, including small handle mark. Use a neutral closed/recessed door proxy if unreadable; do not infer a wide open aperture or tank. Hollow shell under slope is acceptable but interior stair is out of scope.

opening_controls.north_straight: 3 rectangular windows per floor; upper 3 circular vents; lower group has transoms.
opening_controls.west_straight: Upper3 rectangular+3 circular vents+one semicircle; lower2 tall windows with transoms, one round window, and later blocked door (not open restored door).
opening_controls.south: Upper4 rectangular+4 circular vents+one semicircle; lower2 narrow rectangular and1 smaller opening; annex side one small rectangle each floor.
opening_controls.east: Original upper north segment3 rectangular+3 circular; ground full sheet-metal enclosure, upper south enclosed; one upper small annex window. Do not expose hidden original east windows through cladding.
opening_controls.diagonal_entrance: Survey roller shutter and rectangular noticeboards beside it; not restored central double door and not exposed diamond windows. Second-floor narrow outer windows and central pair with top transoms. Original diamond windows visible in interior sections are not grounds to remove exterior survey noticeboards.

go_conditions: Preserve five-sided corner geometry and unequal street wings.
Include survey annex with different one/two-storey portions, and disclosed approximate sloping caps.
No B restoration geometries or cover proposed recolouring used as measured survey.
Use survey red finish supported by photo76 or neutral material approximation; no exact historical colour guarantee.
No detailed structural interior reconstruction, safety certification or trial-print claim.
Public package contains derived controls and citations only, no report pages/photos.
not_resolved: Exact finished-floor heights and centimetre-accurate wall dimensions: graphical controls only.
Roof base heights and minor equipment geometry.
Concealed pre-annex original east wall and original diamond-window exterior under noticeboards.
